# 1 Enoch Chapter 77 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn-astr (Aramaic) | **Section:** Astronomical Book (Book of Luminaries)

---

**77:1** And-the-first-direction is-called the-east, because-it-is-the-first: and-the-second is-called the-south, because-the-Most-High will-descend there, yea, there in-quite-a-special-sense will-He-who-is-blessed-for-ever-descend.

**77:2** And-the-west-direction is-named the-diminished, because-there-all the-luminaries-of-the-heaven wane-and-go-down.

**77:3** And-the-fourth-direction, which-is-named the-north, is-divided-into-three-parts: the-first-of-them is-for the-dwelling of-men, and-the-second-contains-seas-of-water and-the-abysses-and-forests and-rivers and-darkness-and-clouds; and-the-third-part-contains the-garden-of-righteousness.

**77:4** I-saw seven-high-mountains, higher-than-all-the-mountains which-are-on-the-earth; and-thence-comes-forth-hoar-frost, and-days, seasons, and-years-depart and-pass-away.

**77:5** I-saw seven-rivers-on-the-earth larger-than-all-the-rivers; one-of-them coming-from-the-west pours-its-waters-into-the-Great-Sea.

**77:6** And-two-of-them-come-from-the-north-to-the-sea and-pour-their-waters-into-the-Erythraean-Sea-in-the-east.

**77:7** And-the-remaining-four-come-forth-on-the-side-of-the-north to-their-own-sea — two-of-them to-the-Erythraean-Sea, and-two-into-the-Great-Sea — and-some-say-[that-they-discharge-into-the-desert].

**77:8** I-saw seven-great-islands-in-the-sea-and-on-the-land: two-on-the-land-and-five-in-the-Great-Sea.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Chapter 77 provides a geographic/cosmological overview: the four cardinal directions, seven cosmic mountains, seven rivers, and seven islands. The 'Great Sea' = the Mediterranean; the 'Erythraean Sea' = the Red Sea/Indian Ocean. The 'garden of righteousness' in the north (v. 3) may refer to the Garden of Eden or a heavenly paradise.*
